definition: at the top or highest position
description: Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.

en.question: Where does the tennis ball land?

de.answer: Er landet auf dem obersten Ball.
de.question: Wo landet der Tennisball?

es.answer: Cae sobre la pelota de arriba.
es.question: ¿Dónde cae la pelota de tenis?

fr.answer: Elle atterrit sur la balle du haut.
phrases: se prendre la tête entre les mains
